common.forbidden: Your role does not allow this.

login.heading: Sign in
login.totpHelp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.throttled: Too many attempts. Wait 15 minutes and try again.

setup.passwordHelp: At least 12 characters. A long phrase is easiest to remember and hardest to guess.
setup.saved: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.
setup.totpHelp: Scan the code with an authenticator app (Aegis, Bitwarden, 1Password, Google Authenticator…), then type the 6-digit code it shows.
setup.totpDone: Authenticator app set up. Other sessions were signed out.

overview.heading: Overview
overview.workerDownHelp: Jobs wait in the queue until the worker is running.
overview.noData: No data loaded yet. Run “Download and load”.

jobs.heading: Jobs
jobs.alreadyActive: Job #{id} of this kind is already queued or running.

job.heading: Job #{id}
job.cancelRequested: Cancel requested; it stops at the next checkpoint.

upload.heading: Upload an official file
upload.help: For sources that block downloads, or a file you already have. The server recognises the file by its name and content and stores it next to the downloaded ones; then run “Download and load” without download.
upload.done: Uploaded. Job #{id} is placing the file.

users.heading: Users
users.created: User {name} created. Give them the temporary password through a private channel; the first sign-in asks for a new one and an authenticator app.
users.resetDone: Done. Their sessions were signed out.
users.roleHelp: viewer reads; curator also uploads and runs jobs; admin also manages users, schedules and reads the audit log.

us_fetch.title: Download official files
us_fetch.description: Downloads IPEDS, SEVP, the DHS STEM list and DAPIP into the raw store. Nothing changes in the database.

us_sync.title: Download and load
us_sync.description: Downloads (optional) and loads every source for the chosen states. Files already loaded for a state are skipped.

us_recompute.title: Recompute STEM OPT eligibility
us_recompute.description: Recomputes us.stem_opt for every program under the current rule.

us_accept_upload.title: Accept an uploaded file
us_accept_upload.description: Moves an uploaded official file into the raw store.
